scientific_integrity: General formula established by samplewise coupling and an analytic probability integral. Exact finite census independently checked by full permutation enumeration and a first-step rational recurrence. No independence or formal external verification claimed.
scientific_limitations: The infinite positive coupling applies to a star and a clique joined by one edge with at least two leaves and at least two clique vertices. The minimality census concerns all simple graphs of order at most five, not larger orders. Uniform random vertex priorities only. Historical priority is best-knowledge, not independently certified.
title: The five-vertex edge-monotonicity obstruction in random greedy adsorption
